Message.Name: Request Response Message
Message.Description: Request Response messages from the Aggregated Request Server differ in format from that shown in the Common Client Specification.

Field.Name: Msg Size
Field.Description: Size of the message: 21 Bytes

Field.Name: Msg Type
Field.Description: This field identifies the type of message. 11 - Request Response message

Field.Name: RequestSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of the request message sent by the client. This can be used by the client to couple this response with the original request message.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client making the request. This field is up to 9 characters, null terminated.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the request was made (listed in the feed's client specification).

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the request was made.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: The reason why the request was rejected.

Message.Name: Orderbook Snapshot Message
Message.Description: A Snapshot Update message provides the full depth of book for the symbol.

Field.Name: Msg Size
Field.Description: Size of the message.

Field.Name: Msg Type
Field.Description: This field identifies the type of message. 110 - Snapshot Message

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the time when the msg was generated in the order book. The number represents the number of seconds in UTC time (EPOCH)

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: This field represents the nanosecond portion within the second in UTC time (EPOCH)

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: This field identifies the numerical representation of the symbol.

Field.Name: Ultra LastSeqNum
Field.Description: To ease recovery of OpenBook Ultra customers, This field contains the last sequence number of the last message sent out of the OpenBook Ultra feed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: This field contains the full symbol in NYSE Symbology. A sequence of characters representing the symbol, padded with NULLs.

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Price scale for price conversion of the symbol.

Field.Name: TradingStatus
Field.Description: This field indicates the market condition of the security.

Field.Name: RemainingCount
Field.Description: Number of updates remaining in the event.

Field.Name: MPV
Field.Description: This field contains the minimum price variation

Field.Name: UpdateCount
Field.Description: Number of updates. Indicates number of times the following group of fields (Price, Volume, Side, NumOrders) will be repeated in the message. Default value is 1

Field.Name: Snapshot Price Point
Field.Description: Price Point repeating group

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: This field represents the nanosecond portion within the second in UTC time (EPOCH)

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: This field identifies the numerical representation of the symbol.

Field.Name: Ultra LastSeqNum
Field.Description: To ease recovery of OpenBook Ultra customers, This field contains the last sequence number of the last message sent out of the OpenBook Ultra feed.

Field.Name: TradingStatus
Field.Description: This field indicates the market condition of the security.

Field.Name: RemainingCount
Field.Description: Number of updates remaining in the event.

Field.Name: UpdateCount
Field.Description: Number of updates. Indicates number of times the following group of fields (Price, Volume, Side, and NumOrders) will be repeated in the message. Default value is 1

Field.Name: Delta Price Point

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: This field contains the price point. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: Volume

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: This field indicates the side of the order

Field.Name: NumOrders
Field.Description: This field contains the number of orders at the current price point
